subject: Renewal commit clarity & churn risk roundup
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@brightline.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning — observed usage dip and questions

Hi Nikhil,

Quick note as we start renewal planning for Brightline Media (term ends 2026-10-31). We saw a 28% decline in API calls in July compared to May — attached the raw export (usage-stats-JUL2026.csv).

Two asks:
- Can you confirm what a one-year committed ARR would look like given last 3 months' usage trend? We want to avoid large overage surprises.
- What flexibility do you offer on short-term credit or pro-rated adjustments if usage rebounds after a marketing campaign in Q4?

Also, pricing in the current SOW references per-token tiers we think are out of date — can someone send the latest SOW and a recommended commit? We have a procurement window in early September.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Wu
Head of Platform
Brightline Media
alex.wu@brightline.com
Attachments: usage-stats-JUL2026.csv (csv)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — observed usage dip and questions

Hi Alex — thanks for the upload and the heads-up. I reviewed the CSV quickly; looks like a product-usage shift rather than a platform issue (we can dig deeper if you'd like).

Plan / next steps I suggest:
1) Internal quick sync: I'll pull a 90-day normalized usage curve and propose three commit scenarios (conservative / likely / upside) with expected ARR and estimated overage exposure.
2) Finance check: I'll loop in Marissa for a recommended commit shape (monthly vs. annual blend) and any short-term credit policy.
3) Ops handoff: David, can you check whether recent throttles or tokenization changes might have affected counts?

Proposed timing: I can get the commit scenarios and an updated SOW draft to you by EOD Monday (2026-08-24). If that works, can you confirm the procurement team contact and whether the renewal is on the Oct 31 end date?

If you prefer a live 30-min walkthrough with the procurement/finance folks, we can book time next week.

Cheers,
Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Renewal Sales
Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@brightline.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — proposed commit scenarios and SOW next steps

Hi all — jumping in from Finance. I reviewed the initial numbers Nikhil mentioned (preliminary). A few notes and recommended approach: 

Summary (quick):
- Using last 90 days and smoothing anomalies, three recommended annual commit bands are:
  • Conservative: $180k (covers baseline 60th percentile usage)
  • Expected: $240k (covers 80th percentile)
  • Upside: $320k (covers 95th percentile and provides buffer for Q4 campaign)
- Estimated overage exposure (if commit = Expected): ~10–18% depending on burst cadence.

Credit / flexibility policy:
- We can offer a one-time contingent credit up to 8% of annual committed spend if Brightline hits a documented drop below baseline for a sustained quarter, to be reconciled at renewal. This requires sign-off and is tracked on the SOW appendix.

Action items for Alex / Brightline procurement:
- Confirm renewal date (we have 2026-10-31 as the current term end).
- If you want the contingent credit, let us know and we'll add Appendix B to the SOW language.
- Provide the procurement contact email for contract routing (DocuSign).

Attachments: Brightline_SOW_v3.pdf (draft with placeholders for commit bands and Appendix B).

Nikhil — I'll prepare a short table with the three commit options and per-month phasing. Can you please include any known product changes that drove the July dip (David)? Also Naomi, FYI for ARR forecasting and renewal cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Commercial
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@brightline.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, contracts@brightline.com
Date: 2026-08-22T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — acceptance of Expected band and next steps

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. We spoke internally and plan to proceed with the Expected band ($240k) with the contingent credit Appendix B included. Procurement contact is: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@brightline.com>.

Please:
- Send an updated SOW reflecting the Expected commit and Appendix B for our legal review (we aim to sign by 2026-09-10).
- If possible, add a one-month ramp window (September) where overages are billed but credited back at reconciliation to avoid surprises while we run the Q4 campaign test.

On the usage dip: our product team confirmed a UI experiment in July that temporarily redirected some traffic to a partner widget; it should normalize in August. We'll share a postmortem if that helps.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to the SOW.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Wu
Head of Platform
Brightline Media
alex.wu@brightline.com
